mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are holding at 50 degrees at Verona Community Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. Looking ahead, the overnight low will reach 49 degrees with rain in the forecast. Additionally, the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona reminds residents that winter parking rules are starting soon, requiring alternate-side parking from November 20 through April 1 to assist with snow removal. Also, please note that the Senior Center will be closed for the upcoming Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do around town, starting with the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat taking place today. Tomorrow, you can head downtown for the Dane County Farmers' Market, and looking further ahead, check out Trivia nights at local breweries starting on November 4.

Regarding local public safety, officers handled a call on October 25 where a 40-year-old man was taken into custody for an O W I after being located at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's featured flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
